OOS_protocol.data_window: to be fixed in the registration before any data is read
OOS_protocol.train_test_boundary: pairs and hedge ratios frozen at each fold's train end; evaluated on the following window only

counterparty: flow traders in the over/under-valued leg who pay for immediacy
drawdown_model: spread drawdown on price P&L; not measured
economic_mechanism: Counterparty: whoever trades the relative mispricing for flow reasons (forced rebalancing, one-sided retail demand) and pays the reversion. Persists only while the shared factor drives both assets; disappears when the relationship breaks (regime change, token-specific news), which is the dominant risk: cointegration estimated in-sample routinely fails out of sample.
eligibility_rules: pair selected using data strictly before the fold's train end
pair-selection counts as variants (every pair examined is a tested variant)
entry: spread z-score beyond a registered threshold (as-of)
exit: z-score reverts, stop at a registered divergence, or time stop
hypothesis: The log price ratio of two cointegrated assets mean-reverts; trade the spread dollar-neutral.
prospective_protocol: register the pair rule then observe forward without re-selecting pairs
rejection_conditions: number of pairs examined is not recorded in the variant ledger
cointegration test fails in the out-of-sample window
net edge after costs not positive

required_data.gap: BTC/ETH/SOL spot 1h exists for survivors only; no delisted names
required_data.name: synchronised prices of both legs, at least hourly, PIT universe incl. delisted assets

risk_model: relationship break; both legs liquidate against you in a squeeze; funding asymmetry
status_note: SPECIFICATION ONLY. Nothing has been tested; this is not a winner. A bias_declaration is True only where the data needed to rule that bias out is in the repo; it is False wherever a required_data item with repo_has=false names it in declaration_keys. Such a candidate is not yet a testable specification (the verdict reports BIAS_NOT_RULED_OUT) until that data is collected.
